name: handoff
description: Save a session handoff to disk and restore it in a fresh session by id. /handoff saves and returns an id; /handon <id> resumes; /ahandoff does it automatically at a context threshold (handoff → /clear → /handon → continue).

threshold.title: ahandoff: context threshold (%)
threshold.description: Past this context usage the auto handoff kicks in (handoff → /clear → /handon → continue).

checkEvery.title: ahandoff: check every N tool calls
checkEvery.description: How often, in tool calls, the context usage is read mid-turn.

autoOn.title: ahandoff: on at session start
autoOn.description: Start every session with the auto handoff loop armed (continuation = the last prompt you typed).
